name: singlet_trajectory_branch_point_assignment
title: Branch point and branch assignment
description: Finds where lineages split along a trajectory and assigns each cell to a branch as hard labels, soft weights or fate probabilities. Needs an embedding, a graph or pseudotime, and a root cell. Default method is palantir; use scfates for a principal tree with per-gene fork tests. Writes obs/branch_label, obsm/branch_weights and uns/branch_points. Do not use without a root (use trajectory.root_identification first) or to order cells alone.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: palantir: soft fate probabilities; scfates: principal tree with fork tests; slingshot: lineage curves and weights.

embedding.description: obsm key of the embedding used for the graph and branch geometry.

root.description: obs column with one TRUE start cell, or a cell identifier. Required; the tool never infers a root.

terminal_key.description: uns key listing terminal states; null uses the method's own terminal-state step.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for Palantir waypoint sampling and other stochastic steps.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

palantir.description: Options used when method is palantir.

knn.description: Neighbours in the kNN graph and the Markov chain.

num_waypoints.description: Waypoints for the absorbing chain; raised if too small for the components.

scale_components.description: Min-max scale diffusion components before pseudotime.

scfates.description: Options used when method is scfates.

nodes.description: Principal-tree node count; required when method is scfates.

tree_method.description: ppt: principal tree fit; epg: ElPiGraph elastic graph.

epg_lambda.description: ElPiGraph stretching penalty; used when tree_method is epg.

epg_mu.description: ElPiGraph bending penalty; used when tree_method is epg.

fork_fdr.description: FDR cutoff for genes that differ between branches in fork tests.

slingshot.description: Options used when method is slingshot.

cluster_key.description: obs column with cluster labels for the cluster-level minimum spanning tree.

shrink.description: Shrink branching lineages toward their average before the split.

reweight.description: Reweight cells shared between lineages during curve fitting.

approx_points.description: Points used to approximate each curve; null uses 150 when cells exceed 150.

branch_threshold.description: Minimum soft weight for a hard label; null uses 1/L.

omega.description: Cap MST edge length using an artificial outgroup cluster.

omega_scale.description: Scale factor for omega when omega is true.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/branch_label. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed fits: method, n_branches, n_branch_points, branch_points (node, pseudotime), effective_num_waypoints.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
